en.headline: Candlelight string concerts return to PMQ this weekend
en.dek: PMQ lists two Fever concerts on Saturday and Sunday at the Qube, with sittings at 5pm and 7pm and tickets from 130 dollars.
body: String concerts under the Candlelight series are listed at PMQ in Sheung Wan for this weekend, according to the venue's event page.
PMQ says the concerts run on Saturday and Sunday, 10 and 11 October, with sittings at 5pm and 7pm. The venue is the Qube on the second floor. The series is presented and organised by Fever.
Tickets start at 130 dollars, the page says. Further dates at the same room are listed for 23 and 24 October. PMQ's enquiry line for the event is 8009 3124.

zh.headline: 燭光弦樂音樂會今個周末再於元創方演出
zh.dek: 元創方活動頁列出周六及周日於Qube舉行兩場，下午5時及7時開場，票價由130元起。
body: 上環元創方活動頁列出，Candlelight 弦樂音樂會今個周末在場內演出。
元創方表示，演出日期為10月10日及11日，即周六及周日，場次為下午5時及7時，地點是2樓Qube。系列由Fever主辦。
活動頁列門票由130元起。同場地另有10月23日及24日的場次。查詢電話為8009 3124。
